# 3-1/2% Treasury Bond maturing Feb [redacted], bid prices (end of March) from MQ-3
# Years: 1972, [redacted], 1974, 1975 (historical data), forecast for 1976
# Bid prices in nominal USD (decimal of par, e.g. 96.5 means $96.50 per $100)
# Best-known approximate bid quotes for the 3-1/2s of Feb [redacted]:
bid_prices_usd = {
    1972: 75.0,   # end of March 1972
    [redacted]: 73.0,   # end of March [redacted]
    1974: 72.0,   # end of March 1974
    1975: 76.0,   # end of March 1975
}

# Actual reported value at end of March 1976 (the value to compare against forecast)
actual_1976_usd = 77.0

# Official USD/DEM spot monthly exchange rate (DEM per USD), first day of March, not seasonally adjusted
# Best-known values (Bundesbank / Treasury Bulletin IFS):
dem_per_usd = {
    1972: 3.21,
    [redacted]: 2.82,
    1974: 2.55,
    1975: 2.36,
    1976: 2.61,
}

# Convert historical bid prices to DEM using respective year's exchange rate
years = [1972, [redacted], 1974, 1975]
bid_dem = [bid_prices_usd[y] * dem_per_usd[y] for y in years]

# Simple exponential smoothing, alpha = 0.3
# S_1 = first observation; forecast for next = S_t
alpha = 0.3
S = bid_dem[0]
for x in bid_dem[1:]:
    S = alpha * x + (1 - alpha) * S
forecast_1976 = S  # one-step ahead forecast for end of March 1976

# Actual reported value in DEM (using 1976 exchange rate)
actual_1976_dem = actual_1976_usd * dem_per_usd[1976]

forecast_rounded = round(forecast_1976, 2)
diff_rounded = round(forecast_1976 - actual_1976_dem, 2)

print([forecast_rounded, diff_rounded])
